name: Parse and normalize an exact decimal amount
description: Accepts an amount as a decimal lexical token or as an explicit coefficient-and-scale pair, and produces a normalized sign, coefficient and scale together with the canonical lexical form. Rejects any input that cannot be held exactly at the declared scale; it never rounds silently and never accepts a binary floating-point source as authoritative.
inputs: Amount as a decimal lexical token or as an explicit coefficient-and-scale pair
Declared scale for the host field
Total-digit and fraction-digit bounds in force
Negative-zero policy
outputs: Normalized sign, coefficient and scale
Canonical lexical form of the amount
Parse and validation diagnostics
preconditions: The input is a decimal lexical form or an exact coefficient-and-scale pair, not a binary floating-point value
The declared scale and digit bounds are supplied by the host or profile
The negative-zero policy is declared where a signed zero can occur
effects: Rejects an input that is not exactly representable at the declared scale and records the reason
Preserves the declared scale so that trailing-zero significance is not lost
Produces a canonical form suitable for storage, hashing and equality
Performs no rounding, no arithmetic and no currency conversion

name: Validate the currency reference against the pinned catalogue edition
description: Resolves the declared currency code against the pinned, integrity-verified catalogue snapshot and reports the entry's class, status and published minor unit, or reports the code as unresolved. It reads the catalogue; it never allocates, amends or withdraws a code, and it never substitutes a default currency.
inputs: Alphabetic currency code and optional numeric code
Catalogue identifier, list designator and pinned published edition
Integrity digest of the retained catalogue snapshot
Set of code classes the host field permits
outputs: Resolution status for the code
Resolved code class and status as at the pinned edition
Published minor unit value or an explicit not-applicable flag
Mismatch and unresolved diagnostics
preconditions: A catalogue snapshot for the declared edition is retained and its digest verifies
The catalogue and list the code belongs to are declared on the reference
The host has declared which code classes it accepts
effects: Marks an unresolved or class-disallowed code explicitly rather than substituting any currency
Reports disagreement between the alphabetic and numeric forms without choosing one silently
Forces an explicit host-declared scale when the catalogue publishes no applicable minor unit
Makes no change to catalogue content and no assertion about jurisdiction, legal tender or exchangeability

name: Determine the declared value determinacy state
description: Inspects a monetary declaration and reports whether it asserts an exact point value, an interval, an approximate value or an explicit absence with a reason, flagging contradictory combinations. Its purpose is to keep an absent or unknown value from collapsing into a numeric zero.
inputs: Monetary declaration payload
Declared determinacy-state vocabulary
Declared absent-reason vocabulary
Interval endpoints where present
outputs: Determinacy state code
Absent reason where the declaration asserts no amount
Interval endpoint set with inclusivity flags
Contradiction diagnostics
preconditions: The adopting Dimension has declared the determinacy-state and absent-reason vocabularies
Interval endpoints, where present, each carry a currency reference and a declared scale
effects: Rejects a numeric zero offered in place of an absent, unknown or not-applicable value
Flags a declaration that simultaneously asserts an amount and an absence
Flags interval endpoints whose currency references or scales disagree
Assigns no business meaning to the state and takes no action on the host record

name: Compare exact same-currency representations
description: Compares two exact point declarations that resolve to the same currency code under the same catalogue, returning an ordering or equality result. Whether the two declarations are policy-compatible for comparison is supplied externally; the function neither judges compatibility nor converts between currencies.
inputs: Two normalized monetary declarations
Externally supplied policy-compatibility assertion
Trailing-zero significance policy to apply to equality
outputs: Comparison result, or an explicit not-comparable outcome
Reason code when comparison is refused
Statement of the equality semantics applied
preconditions: Both declarations assert an exact point value rather than an interval, approximation or absence
Both currency references resolve to the same code under the same catalogue and pinned edition
A policy-compatibility assertion is supplied by the caller
effects: Refuses comparison across differing currency codes or differing catalogues and returns a reason
Refuses comparison when the external compatibility assertion is missing
Distinguishes numeric equality from representational identity according to the trailing-zero policy
Performs no currency conversion, no rate lookup and no arithmetic beyond comparison

name: Validate a monetary precision and rounding policy declaration
description: Checks that a declared precision and rounding policy is complete, internally consistent and resolvable: currency binding with a pinned list version, declared scale or increment, rounding mode, tie rule, precision tier and channel scope.
inputs: policy declaration under review
currency precision profile snapshot reference
exchange-profile digit limits where a profile is named
outputs: validation verdict of valid, invalid or incomplete
defect list naming the declaration element at fault for each unmet requirement
resolved effective policy view for the caller
preconditions: the currency code resolves within a pinned maintenance-agency list version
the policy declares an effective-from timestamp
effects: returns a verdict and defect list to the caller
does not alter any monetary value, and does not apply, enforce or persist the policy

name: Quantize an amount under an explicitly named rule
description: Applies one named quantization rule — target exponent or non-decimal increment, mode, tie handling — to an amount and returns the quantized value together with every condition raised. No default rule is supplied: an unnamed rule is a failure, never a licence to assume two decimals or half-up.
inputs: source amount with its currency binding
quantization policy record reference and version
arithmetic context precision and digit capacity
outputs: quantized amount carrying its declared scale or increment
raised signal set covering inexact, rounded, clamped, invalid-operation, overflow and underflow
rule reference and version stamped onto the result
preconditions: the caller names a quantization rule explicitly
the target exponent or increment is representable within the declared digit capacity
effects: returns a new value; the source value is not mutated
raises an explicit failure when the result is not representable, instead of truncating or clamping silently
does not persist the result, enforce the rule or write an audit entry

name: Expose the residual introduced by quantization
description: Computes the signed difference between a pre-quantization value and its quantized result, or between two declared precision tiers, and returns it as a first-class amount so the host can disclose, carry or assign it.
inputs: pre-quantization amount
quantized amount
identifiers of the two tiers being compared
host-supplied tolerance threshold where one is provided
outputs: residual amount with currency binding and scale
direction of the residual relative to the payer
comparison of the residual against the supplied threshold where one is provided
preconditions: both values share the same currency binding
both values reference the same quantization policy version
effects: makes the residual visible to the caller instead of absorbing it
does not decide who bears the residual; that decision belongs to the host or to the applicable rule
does not set or derive the tolerance threshold it reports against

name: Allocate a total into quantized parts that reconcile exactly
description: Distributes a total across parts under a named allocation rule with per-part quantization, assigns the residual to the target designated by the caller's rule, and returns a reconciliation difference that must be zero.
inputs: total amount with its currency binding
allocation basis or weights in a deterministic order
allocation rule reference and version
per-part quantization rule reference
residual assignment target
outputs: ordered set of quantized parts
residual amount and its assigned target
reconciliation difference
reproducibility fingerprint over the recorded inputs and rule versions
preconditions: the allocation rule and the residual assignment target are stated explicitly
every part shares the total's currency binding
the input ordering is deterministic
effects: guarantees that the sum of parts plus the assigned residual equals the total, or fails explicitly
returns the result to the caller without posting, settling, enforcing or auditing it

name: Compare, order or aggregate values only under a compatible context
description: Evaluates the compatibility predicate over currency binding, valuation basis and rounding context, and only then compares, orders or sums the values; otherwise it refuses with a typed incompatibility reason. It never converts, normalises or coerces implicitly.
inputs: set of monetary values with their context declarations
requested operation of equality, ordering or aggregation
equality semantics selection
host-supplied tolerance where the operation permits one
outputs: operation result with the governing context stamped onto it
typed refusal naming the incompatible attributes where the predicate fails
record of the tolerance applied and its owner reference
preconditions: every input value declares a currency binding and a rounding context
the equality semantics is stated when the values differ in scale
effects: prohibits implicit currency conversion and implicit re-quantization
returns an explicit refusal rather than a best-effort answer
does not source, select or apply an exchange rate, and does not persist the comparison outcome

name: Bind valuation context to an amount
description: Attaches a complete, versioned valuation frame — amount role, valuation instant and temporal kind, measurement basis with its defining authority, and market or scenario reference — to an amount that already exists in its owning record, without altering the amount value or currency.
inputs: Amount instance reference and its currency code
Amount role code with classifier scheme version
Valuation instant with seconds and offset, plus temporal kind
Measurement basis code and defining authority reference
Market, session or scenario reference
outputs: Bound valuation context attached to the amount instance
Completeness report listing any missing mandatory context
Ingestion instant recorded separately from the valuation instant
preconditions: The amount value and ISO 4217 currency designation are already established by the owning system of record
The currency code exists in the register version applicable at the valuation instant
All referenced classifier schemes resolve to a concrete version
effects: Creates a valuation assertion referencing the amount; never modifies the amount value, currency or the owning record
Pins classifier versions so a later scheme change cannot retroactively reinterpret the assertion
Records asserting identity and ingestion instant alongside the valuation instant

name: Select a declared rate under a caller-supplied policy
description: Applies caller-supplied selection criteria — admissible sources, rate type, session, staleness tolerance and fallback order — to the candidate rate references resolvable in the owning publication model, and records which candidate was selected and why the others were not.
inputs: Base and quote currency codes and required direction
Valuation instant and required effective coverage
Caller-supplied selection policy identifier and criteria set
outputs: Selected rate reference with series and observation key, effective interval, status and declared accuracy
Rejection reasons for each considered candidate
Record of the policy identifier and version that was applied
preconditions: Candidate rate references are resolvable in the owning publication model
The caller supplies the selection criteria; this model holds no default policy of its own
The requested currency pair is not suspended by the chosen source at the valuation instant
effects: Records a selection outcome bound to the valuation assertion
Performs no rate determination, calculation, aggregation or benchmark administration
Applies declared criteria deterministically and records the result; policy authoring, approval, runtime evaluation and enforcement remain with the adopting Dimension's policy model

name: Calculate a reproducible conversion
description: Derives a converted amount from a preserved original using the selected rate or rate chain, applying a declared equation, chain ordering and rounding parameters, and emitting the full reproduction input set alongside the result.
inputs: Original amount value and currency code
Selected rate reference or ordered rate chain with pivot currencies
Derivation method, working precision, rounding mode and target minor unit
outputs: Converted amount value with declared accuracy and target currency code
Conversion equation expression and ordered rounding trace
Reproduction input set and its content digest
preconditions: The selected rate covers the valuation instant and satisfies the declared staleness tolerance
The target currency minor unit resolves from the ISO 4217 register version applicable at the valuation instant
Any intermediate chain step declares whether rounding is permitted at that step
effects: Creates a converted amount linked to the original; the original is never overwritten, replaced or masked
Records the equation, chain and rounding order so the result can be independently recomputed
Leaves fees, spreads, mark-ups and taxes as separate references and never folds them into the rate or the converted amount

name: Reconcile original and reported values
description: Recomputes a stored converted or reported amount from its retained reproduction inputs and compares the result with the stored value, classifying the outcome against the declared tolerance.
inputs: Original amount and the stored converted or reported amount
Reproduction input set with pinned versions
Declared recomputation tolerance
outputs: Reconciliation outcome: reproduced, within tolerance, or disputed
Residual difference expressed in the target currency minor unit
Discrepancy findings identifying the divergent input
preconditions: Both amounts carry declared role codes and a shared derivation lineage
The reproduction input set is complete and its references still resolve
The tolerance has a named owner and version
effects: Records the reconciliation outcome against the valuation assertion
Marks a disputed assertion for correction rather than silently recomputing or overwriting the stored value
Does not post accounting entries, adjust ledgers or execute remediation; those belong to the accounting and workflow models

name: Record a correction or supersession
description: Issues a correcting valuation assertion that supersedes a prior one, capturing the reason, effective interval, issuer and approver, and emitting a serially numbered correction notice for the referenced notification and audit models.
inputs: Reference to the assertion being superseded
Correction reason code and triggering event reference
Corrected context or values with pinned classifier versions
Issuer identity and independent approver identity
outputs: New valuation assertion with a supersession link
Updated state on the superseded assertion
Serially numbered valuation correction notice
preconditions: The superseded assertion exists and its computational fields are immutable
The issuer is authorised and the approver is independent of the consumer of the corrected value
The correction reason maps to a governed reason code
effects: Appends a new assertion and marks the prior one superseded without mutating it; identifiers of superseded assertions are never reused
Emits the correction notice; delivery to downstream consumers, audit-trail persistence and retention execution are performed by the referenced notification, audit and retention models
Never rewrites, revises or re-publishes the source rate, which remains under the publisher's own revision regime

name: Check accountable role completeness
description: Compare the declared role assignments for a monetary assertion against the role set required by its governing profile and report missing or expired assignments.
inputs: monetary assertion reference
declared role assignment set
governing profile reference
outputs: role completeness report
missing role list
expired assignment list
preconditions: The assertion carries a host reference and a role on host
A governing profile version is pinned or a default profile is declared
effects: Emits an advisory report only; assigns no permission, blocks no operation and creates no obligation

name: Check segregation of duties declarations
description: Test whether preparer, independent reviewer and approver references are distinct parties and, where they are not, whether a relief declaration with a compensating measure is present and unexpired.
inputs: preparer reference
reviewer reference
approver reference
segregation relief declaration
outputs: segregation check result
overlapping position list
unmitigated overlap list
preconditions: Party references resolve to distinguishable identifiers
Relief rules are declared with an effective interval
effects: Produces a declarative finding; does not decide whether the control is effective and does not stand in for audit testing

name: Resolve the effective monetary assertion
description: Given a host reference, a role on host and a point in time, return the assertion version whose effective interval covers that point, together with its status and any superseding version.
inputs: host reference
role on host
point in time
outputs: effective assertion version
assertion status
superseding version reference or none
preconditions: Effective intervals and recorded-at timestamps are present with explicit offsets
At most one non-superseded version covers the requested point
effects: Read-only resolution; writes nothing and does not alter status

name: Check currency-list and policy pins
description: Verify that the currency code-list pin and policy version pins are present and resolvable, and flag a code that has become historic or been replaced relative to the pinned list.
inputs: currency code
currency code-list pin
policy version pin set
outputs: pin resolution report
code status finding
unpinned reference list
preconditions: Read access to the published code-list edition named in the pin
Policy references expose a version label or a content digest
effects: Reports drift between pinned and current references; never amends the register and never changes the stored currency code

name: Verify provenance chain completeness
description: Check that a derived monetary value carries an original value reference, a derivation activity, an applied rate with its reference instant and retrieval time, and an attributed agent, and report which links are absent.
inputs: derived value assertion
lineage fields
required lineage profile
outputs: provenance completeness report
missing link list
recomputability indicator
preconditions: The value is declared as derived rather than original
Timestamps are expressed with explicit offsets
effects: Emits a completeness report; performs no market-data retrieval and does not re-derive the value

name: Verify evidence integrity against manifest
description: Recompute digests for referenced evidence items and compare them with the recorded integrity manifest, reporting mismatches, missing items and unrecorded additions.
inputs: evidence item set
integrity manifest
digest algorithm
outputs: integrity verification report
mismatch list
unverifiable item list
preconditions: Evidence items are readable at their recorded references
The manifest records algorithm and computation time for each entry
effects: Reports discrepancies without remediating, quarantining or deleting evidence; does not constitute audit evidence of control operation

name: Derive published access attributes
description: Compute the object attribute set and declared scopes that an external decision point consumes, from sensitivity class, restriction basis, handling labels and access exception declarations.
inputs: sensitivity class
restriction basis
handling label set
access exception declarations
outputs: published attribute set
declared scope list
projection constraint list
preconditions: A sensitivity class is declared or a default class is pinned by the governing profile
effects: Publishes attributes only; renders no permit or deny decision, enforces nothing and discharges no obligation

name: Assess disposition readiness
description: Determine whether the retention period computed from the trigger event has elapsed, whether any legal hold is active, and whether the host record's period is longer, and report an eligibility outcome.
inputs: retention class
retention trigger event and time
legal hold flag
host retention period
outputs: disposition readiness report
eligible-from timestamp
blocking reason list
preconditions: A retention class and trigger event are declared
Hold status is current at evaluation time
effects: Advisory readiness assessment only; the records programme executes disposal, transfer and destruction and owns the disposition record

name: Report profile conformance and mapping loss
description: Check mapping completeness against a named external representation and emit an alignment or conformance report listing mapped fields, unmapped fields and declared losses.
inputs: governing profile reference
mapping table
target representation version
outputs: conformance report
unmapped field list
declared loss list
preconditions: The target representation version is identified or a content digest is recorded
Required checks for a conformance claim are declared
effects: Records an alignment by default and a conformance claim only where the declared checks pass and are evidenced; asserts nothing about the external system's behaviour

name: Resolve effective monetary assertion version
description: Select exactly one version of a bound monetary assertion for a stated effective instant and observation cut-off, and return it verbatim with a reproducible selection trace.
inputs: Assertion identifier or host anchor with attribute path
Requested effective instant
Requested observation cut-off instant
Interval boundary convention and tie-break key in force
outputs: Selected version identifier and validator, or an explicit none-applicable outcome
Verbatim amount string, declared scale and referenced currency code
Currency register list and status that applied at the effective instant
Ordered selection trace and, on failure, a structured failure descriptor
preconditions: The assertion identifier or host anchor is syntactically resolvable
Both instants are RFC 3339 values carrying seconds and an explicit offset or Z
The version series is readable and its effective intervals are well formed
effects: Returns a declarative resolution result only
Performs no write, no conversion, no rounding and no re-scaling
Emits no audit entry; audit capture belongs to the external audit component

name: Check binding and creation preconditions
description: Evaluate every precondition for creating a monetary assertion and binding it to a host anchor, including currency-register validity, scale consistency, anchor resolvability and idempotency key state, and emit the precondition report.
inputs: Proposed assertion payload in canonical form
Host anchor reference and attribute path
Idempotency key and prior-request state where supplied
Applicable currency register lists and minor-unit reference values
outputs: Binding precondition and idempotency report with per-check verdicts and severities
Aggregate accept or reject recommendation
Computed request fingerprint
Structured failure descriptor for each failing check
preconditions: The canonical form of the payload can be computed
The currency register reference is resolvable for the effective instant
The host anchor reference is well formed
effects: Produces a report; creates and persists nothing
Does not reserve, lock or allocate any identifier in the host
Makes no authorization decision and enforces no outcome

name: Plan a correction by supersession
description: Compose a correction plan that names the version to be superseded and its validator, states the replacement values, closes the prior effective interval, and reports overlap and gap conditions across the version series.
inputs: Target assertion version identifier and the validator observed on the last read
Proposed replacement amount, currency reference, scale and effective interval
Correction reason code, justification and responsible agent reference
Existing version series with its effective intervals
outputs: Monetary assertion correction plan
Interval overlap and gap findings across the series
Retroactivity flag and the required conditional predicate for submission
Enumerated failure outcomes for a stale validator or an ill-formed interval
preconditions: The target version exists and is readable
A validator for the target version has been supplied
The proposed interval is well formed under the declared boundary convention
effects: Produces a proposal; applies nothing and mutates no stored version
Never rewrites the superseded version or reuses its identifier
Leaves acceptance, ordering and persistence entirely to the host

name: Compile review and approval evidence
description: Assemble the evidence set for a proposed monetary state change, verify evidence validity intervals, status and securing proofs, and report completeness with named gaps.
inputs: Reference to the precondition report or correction plan under review, pinned by digest
Reviewer identity references and asserted mandate references
Recorded review decisions and their instants
Status or revocation references for each evidence item
outputs: Monetary change review record
Per-item validity, status and integrity verification outcomes
Completeness verdict listing every missing or stale item by name
Structured failure descriptor where evidence cannot be verified
preconditions: The reviewed plan or report is retrievable and its digest can be recomputed
Each evidence item exposes a validity interval or an explicit absence statement
Status references, where present, are resolvable
effects: Produces a compiled evidence record only
Does not approve, reject or enforce anything and issues no credential
Does not operate a status list; revocation is owned by the issuing party

name: Report advisory eligibility for a monetary operation
description: Assemble the subject, object, operation and environment attributes for a requested read or change and emit a non-binding eligibility statement that names the external component holding decision authority.
inputs: Requested action and the target assertion version with its validator
Subject attribute references supplied by the caller or an attribute source
Object attributes of the assertion and its host anchor
Environment attributes such as request instant and channel reference
outputs: Advisory eligibility verdict drawn from eligible, not-eligible, indeterminate or not-applicable
The attribute set as supplied, with sources and observation instants
Explicit disclaimer naming the external decision point as the holder of permit or deny
Structured failure descriptor when required attributes cannot be resolved
preconditions: The target assertion version is identifiable
The requested action is one of the operations defined by this model
Attribute sources, where referenced, are resolvable or explicitly recorded as unavailable
effects: Emits an advisory statement that may be safely disregarded
Renders no authorization decision and performs no enforcement
Grants, denies and revokes nothing, and writes no access log

name: Report disposition readiness
description: Assess whether a monetary assertion is ready for removal by collecting holds in force, the referenced retention class, reference-integrity results and outstanding blockers, and emit the readiness report with proposed tombstone content.
inputs: Assertion identifier and its full version series
Hold and freeze references applying to the assertion or its host
Retention class reference and its owning authority
Inbound reference inventory from the host and from prior versions
outputs: Disposition readiness report
Blocker list with types, severities and external owners
Proposed tombstone content excluding amount, currency and interval values
Aggregate verdict of ready, blocked or indeterminate with a re-evaluation instant
preconditions: Hold and retention references are resolvable, or their unavailability is recorded as a blocker
The version series and its invalidation markers are readable
The inbound reference inventory can be enumerated or its incompleteness is declared
effects: Produces a readiness assessment only
Deletes, destroys, transfers and anonymises nothing
Never asserts that disposition occurred; execution belongs to the records authority and the host

name: Describe an operation failure
description: Render any refusal, precondition failure, conflict or unresolvable reference from the operations above as a machine-identifiable failure descriptor with a resolvable type and a stable title.
inputs: Failing operation identifier and its inputs digest
Failure category such as unknown identifier, unresolvable binding, stale validator, duplicate in flight, fingerprint mismatch, tombstoned, blocked by hold or unverifiable evidence
Contextual references relevant to the failure
Observation instant of the failure
outputs: Failure descriptor carrying a resolvable type identifier, stable title, status, instance and detail
Extension members naming the target assertion version, validator and offending reference
Remediation instruction where one is defined
Correlation reference for reconciliation with the external audit entry
preconditions: The failure category is drawn from the model's published enumeration
A resolvable type identifier exists for that category
effects: Produces a descriptor only and changes no state
Does not suppress, retry or escalate the failing operation
Writes no audit record; it emits a correlation reference for the audit component to use

name: Validate monetary value
description: Evaluate a monetary value for admissibility against a caller-pinned profile and a referenced currency register version, returning typed outcomes without altering the value.
inputs: monetary value with amount, currency identifier, declared scale, measurement basis and valuation instant
validation profile reference and version
currency register version reference
outputs: admissibility verdict
ordered list of validation outcome codes with severity and attribute pointers
preconditions: Currency register version is resolvable by the caller
Validation profile, if pinned, is resolvable and versioned
Amount is presented as an exact decimal with a declared scale
effects: Emits a verdict and outcome codes only
Performs no coercion, normalisation, persistence, posting or enforcement
Does not resolve or amend the currency register itself

name: Quantise amount
description: Round an exact amount to a target scale under a referenced rounding policy and report the signed residual and the resulting value interval.
inputs: exact decimal amount and currency identifier
target scale or a rule for deriving it from the currency minor unit
rounding policy profile reference and version
outputs: quantised amount with declared decimals
signed residual
implied value interval
exactness indicator and precision-loss outcome code where applicable
preconditions: Amount is exact and admissible
Rounding policy profile is resolvable and its version is pinned
Target scale is either the register minor unit or a pinned deviation with a stated authority
effects: Returns a computed value and residual
Never silently discards the residual: it is reported even when zero
Performs no persistence or ledger allocation of the residual

name: Allocate quantisation residual
description: Distribute the residual arising when a quantised total is split into components, so that the quantised components sum exactly to the quantised total.
inputs: quantised total
component weights or shares
rounding policy profile reference including the allocation method
outputs: quantised component amounts
allocation trace identifying which components absorbed residual units
post-allocation sum check result
preconditions: All components share one currency and one target scale
Allocation method is declared in the referenced policy profile
Total is already quantised
effects: Returns component amounts whose sum equals the given total exactly
Reports the allocation trace for reproduction
Does not post, settle or persist the allocation

name: Value or convert monetary value
description: Restate a monetary value in a target currency or under a target measurement basis using a rate binding supplied by the caller, emitting a complete derivation record.
inputs: source monetary value
target currency identifier and target measurement basis
rate binding with source reference, direction, reference instant, retrieval instant and any chain legs
rounding policy profile reference
reference-time selector and staleness threshold
outputs: derived monetary value carrying the original amount and currency
derivation record
derivation outcome codes
preconditions: Rate binding is supplied; this function never retrieves a rate
Rate reference instant and retrieval instant are both present with explicit offsets
Rate value is non-zero and the quotation direction is stated
Any inverse or chained computation is permitted by the pinned policy
effects: Returns a derived value that never replaces or overwrites the original amount and currency
Emits explicit outcomes for missing, stale, ambiguous or non-exchangeable rates, prohibited inverse, zero or non-positive rate and precision loss instead of substituting a fallback rate
Performs no rate acquisition, accounting recognition, posting or persistence

name: Reconcile monetary values
description: Compare a set of monetary values against a stated total or against one another within a declared tolerance and report the verdict with attribution of any difference.
inputs: reconciliation set with member references, roles and signed weights
reported total where applicable
tolerance declaration and its basis
rounding policy profile reference and derivation record references for restated members
outputs: reconciliation verdict
signed difference with currency
difference attribution
reconciliation statement
preconditions: All members resolve to one common currency
Measurement bases are compatible or their incompatibility is declared
Declared decimals or value intervals are available for each member
Tolerance is declared explicitly and not inferred silently
effects: Reports consistency, inconsistency or non-evaluability
Never adjusts, plugs or writes back a difference
Performs no posting, approval or enforcement of a corrective action

name: Project monetary value to target representation
description: Map a monetary value and its precision into a named target representation, declaring any scaling or rounding introduced by the projection.
inputs: monetary value with declared decimals and exactness indicator
target representation identifier and version with its field mapping rules
scale factor where presentation scaling is requested
outputs: projected value in the target representation
projection manifest entry with lossiness and reconcilability indicators
interoperability outcome codes for unmapped or narrowed constraints
preconditions: Target representation and version are resolvable
Currency identifier is representable in the target representation
Declared decimals are known for the source value
effects: Emits a projected value and a declaration of losses introduced
Flags rather than silently truncates when the target permits fewer digits than the source declares
Performs no transmission, publication, storage or disclosure authorisation

name: Apply authorised redaction to a monetary projection
description: Apply an already-authorised disclosure-protection operation — suppression, banding, controlled rounding or interval publication — to a monetary projection and declare the resulting information loss.
inputs: monetary projection or set of projected values
redaction directive naming the operation, the affected values and the secondary suppression set
authorisation decision reference issued by an external authority
outputs: redacted projection
updated lossiness and reconcilability declaration
information-loss statement and redaction outcome codes
preconditions: An external authorisation decision reference is present; the function never decides authorisation
The redaction directive names a defined protection operation
Any secondary suppression required to protect a primary suppression is supplied in the directive
effects: Returns a degraded projection marked as lossy and, where applicable, non-reconcilable
Never deletes or alters the underlying source value
Performs no authorisation evaluation, enforcement or audit-trail writing
